name: Lilit Krein
source:
Lilith lived her whole life in hell, in her family's palace. Never wanted to learn to fight. Lilith's parents signed a pact with my father that she belonged to [url=https://vndb.org/c144566]me[/url]. She's been watching me for a long time, She's afraid that I won't love her properly.
